Eevee Week 2023 is a week-long event to celebrate Eevee Day (November 21), during which Eevee and its Evolutions are more likely to gather to sleep ! You’ll be able to encounter Pokémon of different sleep types regardless of your own, and Eevee and its Evolutions will be more likely to appear . You might even meet a Shiny Eevee! Also, if you conduct sleep research on Eevee Day (November 21), you can get 1,121 bonus sleep points. You can get nice rewards like Eevee Incense through special missions , which will be available in addition to the usual missions. And during this Eevee week, all of your helper Pokémon’s main skills are more likely to be triggered! We hope you enjoy this great work from your helper Pokémon! Day 1: Monday, November 20, at 4:00 a.m. to Tuesday, November 21, at 3:59 a.m. Day 2 (Eevee Day): Tuesday, November 21, at 4:00 a.m. to Wednesday, November 22, at 3:59 a.m. Day 3: Wednesday, November 22, at 4:00 a.m. to Thursday, November 23, at 3:59 a.m. Day 4: Thursday, November 23, at 4:00 a.m. to Friday, November 24, at 3:59 a.m. Day 5: Friday, November 24, at 4:00 a.m. to Saturday, November 25, at 3:59 a.m. Day 6: Saturday, November 25, at 4.00 a.m. to Sunday, November 26, at 3:59 a.m. Day 7: Sunday, November 26, at 4:00 a.m. to Monday, November 27, at 3:59 a.m. How to Progress in the Event Participating in the event is easy! Simply tap the “Sleep” button during the event period to track your sleep. A variety of event-related effects will be triggered during your sleep research. Note: Event bonuses can be triggered in any area for this event. Event Bonuses — Eevee Day (November 21) — • Greater appearance rate for Eevee and its Evolutions during sleep research • Many Pokémon of different sleep types will appear during sleep research regardless of the researcher’s sleep type for the day. • You may encounter a Shiny Eevee. • +1,121 bonus sleep points • Main skills for all helper Pokémon are 1.5 times more likely to be triggered. — Other Days (November 20 and November 22−26) — • Greater appearance rate for Eevee and its Evolutions during sleep research • A few Pokémon of different sleep types will appear during sleep research regardless of the researcher’s sleep type for the day. • You may encounter a Shiny Eevee. • Main skills for all helper Pokémon are 1.5 times more likely to be triggered. — Pokémon That Are Easier to Encounter Throughout the Event — During the event period, the following Pokémon will be more likely to appear! Much Greater Appearance Rate Eevee Greater Appearance Rate Vaporeon, Jolteon, Flareon, Espeon, Umbreon, Leafeon, Glaceon, Sylveon Notes: The much greater appearance rate for Eevee applies to all areas. The greater appearance rate for other Pokémon applies only to the separate areas where each Pokémon appears. Greengrass Isle: Jolteon, Leafeon, Sylveon Cyan Beach: Vaporeon Taupe Hollow: Flareon, Espeon, Umbreon Snowdrop Tundra: Glaceon You’ll only be able to see one sleep style each for Flareon and Leafeon. Other sleep styles will be viewable in a new area that will be added in the future.
